description: Silver: one row per host, merged from what bronze loaded since the last silver run (an incremental load on _loaded_at). Runs on its own schedule.
sql: SELECT hostname, ip, os, risk, CAST(last_seen AS TIMESTAMP) AS last_seen, _loaded_at FROM lake_bronze_assets QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY hostname ORDER BY _loaded_at DESC) = 1
